scoring_spec.review_method: single-reviewer per-case trace adjudication; retain each dimension, total, rationale, evidence and missing denominator; critical/harmful are separate signals

primary_quality_metrics.name: overall_score
primary_quality_metrics.definition: Arithmetic mean of per-case 0-100 total; report n and missing denominator.

primary_quality_metrics.name: task_type_mean
primary_quality_metrics.definition: Arithmetic mean per task type; report n for every stratum.

primary_quality_metrics.name: task_completion_rate
primary_quality_metrics.definition: Complete / partial / not_complete against the goal and acceptable paths; final ANSWER alone does not imply completion.

primary_quality_metrics.name: answer_validity_rate
primary_quality_metrics.definition: Goal alignment, supported State/evidence, no contradiction with known State, and answer_scope compliance.

primary_quality_metrics.name: critical_failures
primary_quality_metrics.definition: Count and rate of cases with one or more preregistered critical failure types, retaining types and supporting trace.

primary_quality_metrics.name: harmful_failures
primary_quality_metrics.definition: Count and rate adjudicated under the inherited frozen failure definition; report safe bounded incompletion separately.

information_acquisition_metrics.name: ask_per_case
information_acquisition_metrics.definition: All ASK actions divided by completed cases.

information_acquisition_metrics.name: low_value_ask_rate
information_acquisition_metrics.definition: (redundant + irrelevant ASK events) / all ASK events; also publish each category count/rate and necessary/useful rates.

information_acquisition_metrics.name: necessary_ask_preservation
information_acquisition_metrics.definition: Number of necessary targets acquired via semantically equivalent ASK / all oracle-marked necessary ASK targets.

information_acquisition_metrics.name: retrieve_per_case
information_acquisition_metrics.definition: RETRIEVE actions / completed cases; classify each as required, optional/useful, redundant or irrelevant against active evidence dependency and State.

information_acquisition_metrics.name: read_diary_per_case
information_acquisition_metrics.definition: READ_DIARY actions / completed cases; classify each against diary dependency, authorization, availability, loaded/unavailable status and repeated calls.

information_acquisition_metrics.name: ask_quality
information_acquisition_metrics.definition: Manual target-level adjudication against goal, initial/current State, dependency, and acceptable paths; category counts must sum to ASK total.

efficiency_metrics.name: steps_per_case
efficiency_metrics.definition: Recorded internal Agent Loop decision/action steps / completed cases.

efficiency_metrics.name: tool_calls_per_case
efficiency_metrics.definition: Actual RETRIEVE + READ_DIARY executions / completed cases; ASK is not a tool call.

efficiency_metrics.name: latency_ms
efficiency_metrics.definition: Request start through terminal response measured with monotonic clock; report mean, median and nearest-rank p90, overall and by task type. Missing values are NOT_MEASURED.

efficiency_metrics.name: token_usage
efficiency_metrics.definition: Provider-reported input/output/total tokens only; otherwise NOT_MEASURED, never estimated.

failure_attribution.principle: Attribute root cause once; downstream symptoms are not independent failures without separate evidence.

missing_telemetry: NOT_MEASURED / NOT_AVAILABLE; never impute token, model-call, or latency-component values.

development_history.V2: historical development/regression set; not paired to V4
development_history.V3: consumed historical held-out set; not reusable as current-candidate held-out result
